rows.07:1221c:
"...I...'ll... cur...se... you... to... de............a............th"
He collapsed.
It was by no means unforeseeable that Hino would take his own life.
But I couldn't stop him.
I had no chance to stop him, and even if I had, would I have stopped him?
"...If you want to curse me, go ahead and curse me. I'm not afraid of your curse.
Thanks to you, I've found the confidence to live a strong life."
No answer came back from Hino.
By now he must be riding the train to hell.{p}
rows.07:12410:
I stepped into the phone booth outside the school gate.
The morning sun was already starting to show at the far edge of the sky.{p}
rows.07:12b5c: There's no way I'm wagging my tail for a coward like him!{p}
rows.07:13384:
"N... no!"
I can't do that.
I have my pride too!
"Oh, is that so? Then how about I help you lick it?"
Hino snapped his fingers.{p}
rows.07:1491c:
"My, how unfair! {a} is just my type. Please, let me do it too."
Iwashita cut in.{p}
rows.07:14a34:
Fukuzawa gave me a sweet smile.
"It's my first time. Sorry if I don't do it right."
An innocent smile.
She frightened me more than the thought of being killed.
"Don't end it in one blow. I'm the one who'll finish {a} off."
I heard Iwashita's voice.{p}
rows.07:16ef0:
"Where's the ampoule?"
"Hey, hey, you already asked me that. Are you okay?"
This is bad. My head seems to be all muddled.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:168dc:
...Kazama's corpse was still there.
I did my best not to look that way.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:14e48:
"Hurry!"
"Hurry!"
"Hurry or you'll die!"
They all jeered at me together.
...I wanted to beat them to a pulp, but I didn't even have the time to spare for that.
For now, just like they said, finding the antidote came first.{p}
